scope: Real CUDA test consumer: count/byte cache admission, idle LRU and full-state reconstruction on the original Model/Invocation chain.

build.qualification: Only consumer main object changed in the retained closure. Concurrent new paged-append core work was not linked or validated by these runs.

mechanism.auto: Resolve from actual input session count and state budget; no fixed number of users. No preallocation of the configured maximum.
mechanism.budget: Separate ResourceBudget. One aggregate per-session reservation before the first state allocation; released after original slots and state buffers are destroyed.
mechanism.bytes: 39,075,840 + 12,288 * context_capacity;84 dense KV/conv/GDN Buffer requests per session, including both recurrent banks. At256:42,221,568 bytes.
mechanism.retirement: Only idle unpinned entries are eligible. Callback must drain and destroy actual Session before the directory removes its byte charge; failure remains charged and aborts admission.
mechanism.restore: Consumer retains actual input history, reruns original chunks and checks prior output IDs; later endpoint vectors also match the independent baseline.
mechanism.hot_path: Directory/admission/pinning happen at request/turn boundaries. Each decode directly uses its current Session. Cache count1 introduces no different mathematical kernel.

consumer_source_review.scope: Read-only review of the consumer ResourceBudget, bounded SessionCache admission, turn-cohort dispatch, eviction and reconstruction in the exact main.cc identified below.

conclusion.assessment: No necessary bug found in the reviewed synchronous, single-Queue consumer integration. This is source review, not runtime or performance validation.

checked.finding: All schedules and token contexts are validated before Model construction. Parsed schedules are nonempty, with nonempty complete prompt/decode turns. Auto resident count is bounded by manifest count; explicit resident count may be smaller than manifest count. After positive size parsing and the one-session byte check, cached_slots and active_slots are at least one. Explicit active concurrency cannot exceed resident count or the number of state charges fitting cache_bytes; the dispatch loop cannot increment by zero.

checked.topic: Exact managed state charge and exception lifetime
checked.finding: state_bytes uses descriptor required_bytes with checked multiplication/addition. It includes both ping-pong conv and recurrent buffers for 18 linear layers, plus K/V buffers for six attention layers. Session reserves the exact charge before allocating state. cache_reservation is declared before buffers and Invocation owners, so reverse destruction releases those owners before returning the reservation. Partial construction has the same RAII order. Capacity 256 requests 42,221,568 state bytes per Session.
checked.accounting_limit: This is managed KV/conv/GDN state requested-byte admission. Weights, per-Session IO/workspace/capture/provider-private memory, allocator/driver overhead and other processes are not included; the CLI correctly prints physical_vram_limit_known=false.

checked.topic: Shared model and stable owner indices
checked.finding: One Model owns the weights, immutable finite families and Budget before directory/runs are constructed. The fixed runs vector is sized once, and directory entries reference stable numeric run indices. SessionRun declares the Session before its Pin, so the Pin dies first on unwind. All runs die before directory and shared Model; no eviction callback is invoked by directory destruction. Each recreated Session owns independent state and mutable Invocation/IO while borrowing the same family children.

checked.topic: Turn cohorts and the cache-one hot path
checked.finding: Dispatch advances each session cursor in original call order within a complete turn, round-robins calls only inside the active cohort, and completes the cohort before admitting another. Initial active cohort pins are created before ready. A turn stays pinned from its prompt through its last completed decode. Pin reset happens only after evaluate returned and the final host endpoint was recorded. Decode reads the direct Session pointer; it does not call the directory, scan an LRU, take a new budget reservation, or construct an Invocation. A single user with resident limit one retains the same Session across turns.

checked.topic: Eviction and reconstruction preserve owner/history contract
checked.finding: Only idle entries are eligible. The callback rejects a pin, missing owner or failed drain, then destroys the Session before returning true; only then does the directory return the byte/count charge. Failed retirement remains conservatively charged and aborts this process. A miss reconstructs using the original prompt block and each exact original teacher-forced decode ID, preserving chunking/parity rather than concatenating or altering math. It compares every reconstructed next ID to retained history and validates resulting length. Restored calls do not append duplicate logical outputs to history. The post-admission check equates directory state bytes with the real Budget live state reservations.

On a later prompt, phase start and journey start precede ensure_resident, so drain/destruction/allocation/history replay costs occur inside phase/session/interleaved wall time. Logical step_sum_seconds covers only the requested new evaluate calls; cache_prepare_seconds and restored_calls/tokens expose extra preparation/replay work. Initial cohort creation occurs before ready and belongs to startup, though cache_prepare_seconds also includes that initial work. Per-session wall times include interleaved waiting and cannot be added to obtain total journey time; use interleaved_seconds for aggregate logical output TPS. Restoration outputs are intentionally excluded from logical generated_tokens, while restoration time remains in the denominator.

checked.topic: Results remain printable when final Session is evicted
checked.finding: Final printing uses retained visible_tokens, summaries and generated/consumed histories, rather than dereferencing an evicted Session. Complete input validation guarantees front/back uses on schedules/runs have a member. Auto byte-budget multiplication and total call accumulation are checked. Per-session accumulated context is bounded by capacity <= 262144 and the parser uses subtraction guards; fixed per-state dimensions make state size safe under the explicit checked sum.

limitations: No claim of runtime success, speedup or peak physical VRAM is made by this review; root owns actual execution.
ResourceBudget limits only explicitly reserved state bytes; per-session slot/workspace allocations can still fail even when the cache state budget admits an entry.
This consumer uses synchronous serial evaluation and complete-turn active pins. It is not a multithreaded service scheduler, asynchronous paging/cancellation policy, or prefix COW implementation.
History reconstruction is checked against earlier predicted IDs; this check alone is not a bitwise hidden/logits comparison or a model quality proof.
Diagnostic trace/probe and preparation output are not uninstrumented performance measurements. Reconstructed calls are separately named and do not replace original logical observations.
consumer_source_review.parent_action: Safe to proceed to the planned focused build and root-controlled runtime checks without a review-requested source change.

resource_review.conclusion: Existing ResourceBudget/RAII reservations and lease-backed budgets are sufficient mechanisms. Current dense Session allocations do not use them, so cache-only admission requires a small consumer hook. Use a dedicated cache requested-byte scope, not Graph compile budget or device total stats. Keep engine idle LRU/admission policy outside Hyle.

cache_bytes_contract.means: Sum of live managed cache backing requested bytes: complete dense KV plus both conv/GDN generations now; future pooled page backing and temporary COW/generation backings including original native retirement owners. Aliases and readonly snapshots of the same backing do not allocate another charge.
excludes: one shared original model weight bank
per-shape Invocation execution workspace/native graph state
token/position/logits/final_hidden/probe IO and host control metadata unless a separately named budget intentionally includes them
cache_bytes_contract.physical_limit_boundary: This is not an OS/driver-resident VRAM ceiling and cannot guarantee CUDA OOM absence. Drivers, allocator granularity, native-private allocations, Context/modules and other processes remain outside this exact requested-byte accounting.
do_not_derive_from: current visible token length: dense KV is allocated at full context capacity
sum of graph boundary_view_bytes across Invocations: same state is aliased repeatedly
nvidia-smi delta or CUDA resource.stats used_bytes as a cache-only ownership ledger

current_dense_allocation.formula: sum_i_state_schema checked required_bytes, with two history/recurrent generations and one key/value allocation each; current closed form39,075,840 +12,288 * context_capacity
current_dense_allocation.alignment: All84 current allocation sizes are already multiples of256. Buffer requests256 alignment but never pads its size; CUDA minimum alignment is256 and accepts exact size. Thus required_bytes sum is exact for the current managed Buffer request ledger. Driver backing/usable-size overhead remains unknown, not zero.
current_dense_allocation.future_pool_rule: If suballocating a common backing, charge the actual pool capacity once, including alignment gaps/padding and sentinel bytes, not the sum of tensor logical views. Existing PagedArena allocates description.required_bytes()+1 per physical K/V arena.

minimal_consumer_implementation.owner: Model or engine controller in tools/qwen35_text/main.cc
minimal_consumer_implementation.action: Create a dedicated ResourceBudget with one device MemoryResourceRef limit=cache_bytes and a system_resource metadata row with a separate sufficient host limit (SIZE_MAX if intentionally unbounded); default allow_unattributed=false. This scope sees only explicit cache charges.

Checked-add each state_schema required_bytes with its true allocation multiplicity. Validate the ordered plan before attempting admission. Acquire one aggregate cache_budget.reserve(memory.ref(),bytes,kExternal) BEFORE the first of84 CUDA allocations. Use checked addition/subtraction; do not rely on max_sessions alone.

Store the move-only Reservation before the state member declaration so destruction is Phase/InvocationIO then state Buffers then Reservation. Construction failure unwinds partial allocations before returning the quota. Model/cache resource/Context must outlive all Sessions.

On no capacity, choose only idle/unpinned entries. Stop admitting dispatch for a victim, move its original Session owner to a retiring holder if needed, drain original slots and destroy it; quota is reclaimed only after actual owner destruction. Removing a directory key, returning a cancellation, waiting a public Completion or closing a slot must not decrement live cache bytes early. Then retry quota, or explicitly reject/queue if no victim is evictable.

Use the same dedicated cache budget via LeasePool/PagedArena options for native cache backing; keep StateVersion/frame/readers and original Completion guards retaining the charge. Do not additionally reserve the same bytes in a Session aggregate. A long-lived global page pool is charged once at creation; LRU frees page permissions/capacity, not the still-allocated pool charge. Shared pages cost once; COW within free pool consumes free-page headroom, while an additional backing must obtain a new charge before allocation.

Preserve drain/math errors. Ordinary failed-but-actually-retired work can be safely torn down without claiming successful state; unknown/in-flight ownership stays charged. CUDA terminal context/free errors invalidate residency guarantees and require the documented recovery rather than normal LRU admission based solely on reset logical counters. Report live/peak requested cache bytes separately from measured device memory and execution workspace.

confirmed_gaps_and_non_gaps.gap: No cache budget/reservation currently guards raw state Buffer allocation. Existing max_sessions only bounds count. Add the described aggregate reservation; no new public primitive needed.

PagedArena::create allocates Buffer(bytes+1) first, then LeasePool::adopt checks global budget. Rejected creates do roll back, but transient native allocation has already happened. For a strict pre-allocation cache admission policy, move native arena creation through the existing budget-first LeasePool::create lifecycle (with a small private backing-span accessor if needed) or equivalent reserve-before-allocate composition that transfers exactly one charge to the backing domain. Do not manually pre-reserve and also pass the same budget to adopt, which double-charges.

No need for a generic global cache, LRU in Graph, provider/model whitelist, new executor, or categories keyed by model roles. Budget mechanism and actual-retirement retention already exist; engine decides victim policy and re-admission.

retirement_release_rules: Current successful evaluate waits its original Completion and reads the host token. Session destructor drains every original phase slot before Phase IO and state die. Idle currently means no ongoing evaluate and no external owner; the serial consumer has no exported state snapshots.

Invocation::drain closes the slot and waits actual accepted-child guard retirement plus observation callback tail, preserving errors. The Invocation/workspace and cache allocations still remain until owning objects are destroyed.

Raw TensorView bindings are explicitly borrowed and do not make an escaping GraphOutput own a Session raw Buffer. The current diagnostics export copies to files, not independent state leases. Future prefix/fork owners must use actual ready state/page leases, not prolong a raw view by changing an LRU flag.

LeasePool::drain waits uses but deliberately not retained readers. Final ReadLease/subview/native use can keep an entire pool allocation and its reservation alive after the directory, pool handle or StateVersion was dropped. Charge full backing once until that domain actually dies.

A shared paged pool can retain its full allocation after all logical session entries are evicted; reducing occupancy is not a physical cache-byte refund. Distinguish pool reserved bytes, live logical pages and retiring/pinned pages in engine reports.
suggested_finite_checks_for_root_later: cache limit exactly one current Session backing admits one; byte below rejects before any state Buffer allocation; construction failure releases only its own reservation
two resident Sessions exhaust a limit chosen from exact schema bytes; remove an idle victim, prove original drain/destruction then admit replacement without touching shared weights/family
when later using pooled/escaped pages, hold an original page lease/native use beyond directory removal and show quota/backing is not refunded until its last owner retires

source_anchors.fact: Budget limits are per exact MemoryResourceRef, not per category. Scope is managed requested bytes, not physical reservation; metadata resource must be explicitly represented.
RAII Reservation releases quota on reset/destruction; create requires the host metadata row; reserve atomically rejects over-quota and reports ResourceExhausted.
Admission accounts requested live bytes; acquire before backing allocation; destroy external storage before releasing an explicit charge; do not double-charge allocation and reservation.
Buffer::create forwards exact requested size and effective alignment, validates returned token, and reset deallocates that exact allocation; Buffer has no budget parameter or implicit rounding.

CUDA minimum alignment256; cuMemAlloc/Managed/HostAlloc receives exact size, token/stats retain requested bytes. Terminal CUDA free does not prove physical residency was reclaimed; context/process recovery is separate.

Current Session cache uses84 raw Buffers, not budgeted leases. Complete cache state is independently allocated; each Session drains its own Invocations before its Phase IO and state buffers are destroyed.
required_bytes computes checked physical span from dimensions/byte strides or explicit opaque bytes, including descriptor padding; use it rather than element_count times dtype.
CompileOptions.resource_budget covers graph compiled/invocation storage, not cache-only ownership; drain closes admission and waits actual retirement with errors preserved.
Invocation creation reserves known workspace and opaque-private budgets; caller raw state bindings are not auto-charged. Destructor drops retained observation/original state ownership.
Provider state and workspace are destroyed before their invocation reservations are returned; independently retained InvocationState owners can extend charge lifetime.
Actual accepted child guards retire before the Invocation becomes idle/failed. drain waits progress, observer tail and running state; it does not free the Invocation/cache backing.
boundary_view_bytes merges views only for reporting; it is not an automatic external allocation charge. Summing reports across slots would duplicate the same cache.

A budgeted pool charges its full backing capacity once, held by LeaseDomain. Blocks/aliases/native uses retain the domain. close/drain do not destroy retained readers or free persistent pool capacity.
LeasePool accepts existing ResourceBudget; copies/subviews do not allocate new payload. Imported backing actual size/alignment is authoritative.

Arena uses one backing pool plus a1-byte sentinel, holds exact page permissions, and existing budget option attaches to pool. create currently allocates native Buffer before pool-adopt quota reservation.
StateStore backing ledger deduplicates whole backing roots, not logical slice lengths. It is a bounded ownership ledger, not an LRU policy or substitute global physical VRAM meter.

independent_runtime_review.conclusion: All three finite retained/count-bound/byte-bound journeys preserve original per-session hidden/logits bytes, token IDs and contexts. Independent owner-name LRU simulation reproduces six/seven evictions and restoration of the exact original first-turn chunks. Managed cache requested-byte peaks are exactly4/2/1 times42,221,568B. No blocking evidence mismatch found.
scope_limits: Requested state bytes are not physical GPU peak. Model weights, GraphIO/slots/workspace/capture/native-private storage, driver overhead and other processes are outside this cache admission quota.

Restoration counters were independently derived from original call histories and match runtime; source replays the original chunks and checks every restored predictedID. Restoration hidden/logits vectors were not separately exported, so only the subsequent primary decision vectors are byte-compared.
Restoration is full recomputation of the original chunk history, not page/prefix/COW reuse or a cache hit. Each bounded case adds18calls/185tokens; retained adds none.

These are traced diagnostic processes, not throughput or latency comparisons. Actual restoration/preparation remains in complete phase/session timing, while primary step_sum excludes separate restoration work.
No simultaneous GPU execution, async eviction/cancellation failure, new paged append, complete internal-state bit dump, model quality or all-domain qualification is established.

anchors.fact: Strict capacity/active/byte preflight precedes Model creation
LRU victim original Session drains and is destroyed before directory bytes return; missing owner reconstructs the original history chunks and checks outputs/context
Admission occurs at prompt/turn boundary, decode uses original Session; original completed host endpoint precedes unpin
Only idle entries are reclaimed; original retire callback must succeed before retained byte counters decrease

limits: State requested bytes are not physical VRAM; weights, IO/workspace, capture/native private storage, allocator/driver overhead and external processes are separate.
All216 endpoint vectors came from diagnostic export runs, not a new speed/memory-peak comparison.
Each active request is one complete prompt/decode turn; cohorts interleave complete calls on one original queue. No simultaneous GPU batching or service throughput claim.
Eviction restoration is full-history recomputation, not shared-prefix/COW cache reuse.
Shared-prefix/COW, asynchronous page retirement, full MTP, image encoder/projector and architecture completion remain pending.
reproduction: Matching retained model/dependencies are required. Bundle retains input IDs, frozen consumer source/headers,190-input identities, commands, raw logs, hashes, host checks and independent recomputation scripts; no model weights, SDK copies, binaries or duplicate tensor payloads.
